    Talks and presentations

    Video and recorded presentations

    QDTraj - IROS 2026

    October 01, 2026

    3-Minute Video Presentation, IROS 2026, David L. Lawrence Convention Center, Pittsburgh, PA, USA

    A 3-minute video presentation of QDTraj: Exploration of Diverse Trajectory Primitives for Articulated Object Robotic Manipulation, presenting the proposed approach for generating and exploring diverse trajectory primitives for articulated object manipulation.

    Watch on YouTube

    ROSCon France 2026

    June 18, 2026

    10-Minute Presentation, ROSCon 2026, Auditorium Sorbonne University, France

    A 10-minute presentation on the ROS2 architecture and integration for robotic manipulation, covering the integration of simulation, control, and real-robot deployment components.

    Speed-up 6-DoF Grasping - IROS 2024

    October 08, 2024

    3-min Video Presentation, Abu Dhabi, ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi

    A capsule video presenting a speed-up demonstration of 6-DoF grasping, prepared as part of the paper presentation in Abu Dhabi.

    Watch on YouTube

    Other oral presentations, posters and demos

    • March 11, 2025 — Poster, EDITE Doctoral Students' Day, IRCAM, Paris, France. Poster presenting my PhD project on learning robotic grasping and manipulation behaviors, from data generation to skill extraction.
    • May 20, 2025 — Poster and 3-minute presentation, IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2025), Atlanta, USA. Presentation of QDGset, a large-scale grasping dataset generated with Quality-Diversity.
    • September 8, 2025 — Poster, International Conference on Intrinsically Motivated Open-ended Learning (IMOL 2025), University of Hertfordshire, Hatfield, United Kingdom. Presentation of "Towards Robust Prehensile Manipulation in Open-Ended Environments".
    • February 11, 2026 — 3-minute presentation, ROMANDIC Winter School on Robot Handling of Deformable Objects, Kranjska Gora, Slovenia. Short pitch of my research on robotic manipulation and trajectory primitives.
    • May 26, 2026 — 20-minute oral presentation, ISIR Young Scientists' Day, Institute of Intelligent Systems and Robotics (ISIR), Sorbonne University, Paris, France. Overview of my thesis work on diverse trajectory primitives for articulated object manipulation.
    • May 26, 2026 — Poster, ISIR Young Scientists' Day, ISIR, Sorbonne University, Paris, France.
    • June 24, 2026 — 10-minute oral presentation, ROSCon France, Sorbonne University, Paris, France. Presentation of the ROS2 architecture for articulated object manipulation using trajectory primitives learned in simulation.
    • June 25, 2026 — Live real-robot demonstration, ROSCon France, Sorbonne University, Paris, France. Demo of the ROS2 manipulation pipeline running on a Franka FR3 robot.
    • July 1, 2026 — 15-minute oral presentation, Plateforme France Intelligence Artificielle (PFIA 2026), Arras, France. Presentation of my work on trajectory primitives and manipulation learning.
    • October 1, 2026 — Poster and 10-minute presentation, IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026), Pittsburgh, USA. Presentation of QDTraj: exploration of diverse trajectory primitives for articulated object robotic manipulation.
